verdict.rationale: ClickUp works as a shared context hub. Its official MCP server lets external agents such as Claude and ChatGPT read and act on workspace tasks, lists, docs and comments. Its own agents (Super Agent, Codegen, Triage) are marketed as running with 'full context' and 'infinite memory'. Integrations sync GitHub and Slack, and Asana/Jira imports claim 'no data lost'. However, all of this is vendor-claimed, and nothing documents a handoff mechanism between agents or tools that preserves state. Missing for 10: documented agent-to-agent handoff semantics, evidence of how context or state carries over between ClickUp agents and external agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
